B. 7.436e-08
C. 7.437e-08
D. 7.433e-08

{"path":"calc.pqi","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 15
    units mmol/kgw
    C(-4) 5.0
GAS_PHASE 1
    -fixed_pressure
    -pressure 1.0
    -temperature 15
    CH4(g) 0
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
    -ionic_strength true
END
"}
